name: Make a Video Call
description: Help the user make a video call using Zoom, FaceTime, or other apps
prompt:
The user wants to make a video call. FIRST gather context before any navigation:
  1. Ask which app the call uses (FaceTime, Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, Skype) if not known from memory. For iPhone users suggest FaceTime, for everyone else suggest Zoom.
  2. Ask who they're calling (doctor, family member, etc.) — keeps the goal visible.
  3. Reassure them it's normal to feel nervous the first time.

VISUAL GUIDE — ZOOM (when the user says they're joining a Zoom meeting): build an 8-step paginated guide using the illustrated assets. Step 2 picks the right browser variant based on what the user has — if you don't know, ASK ("Which internet app do you usually use? Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari?"). Pattern (replace `<browser>` with chrome / edge / firefox / safari):

  Step 1 (animated overview): image_id `zoom-video-call-demo`. Text: "Here's a quick look at the whole thing — watch this short demo, then we'll do it together."
  Step 2: image_id `zoom-illustrated-step-1-<browser>`. Text: "Open <Browser> from your taskbar." (e.g., "Open Chrome (the colorful circle) from your taskbar.")
  Step 3: image_id `zoom-illustrated-step-2`. Text: "Click in the long white box at the top, type zoom.us, and press Enter on your keyboard."
  Step 4: image_id `zoom-illustrated-step-3`. Text: "Click the blue 'Join a Meeting' button on the Zoom homepage."
  Step 5: image_id `zoom-illustrated-step-4`. Text: "Type the meeting ID number that your doctor or family member sent you. It's usually 9-11 numbers."
  Step 6: image_id `zoom-illustrated-step-5`. Text: "Click the blue Join button."
  Step 7: image_id `zoom-illustrated-step-6`. Text: "Your browser will ask if Zoom can use your camera and microphone — click Allow on both."
  Step 8 (celebration): image_id `zoom-illustrated-step-7`. Text: "You're in the call — wave hello! 🎉"

VISUAL GUIDE — FACETIME (when the user is on iPhone, iPad, or Mac and using FaceTime): build a 7-step paginated guide. FaceTime is a native app (no browser involved) so step 2 doesn't branch.

  Step 1 (animated overview): image_id `facetime-video-call-demo`. Text: "Here's a quick look at the whole thing — watch this short demo, then we'll do it together."
  Step 2: image_id `facetime-illustrated-step-1`. Text: "Open the FaceTime app — look for the green icon with a white video camera in your Dock or apps list."
  Step 3: image_id `facetime-illustrated-step-2`. Text: "Click the New FaceTime button to start a new call."
  Step 4: image_id `facetime-illustrated-step-3`. Text: "Type the name or phone number of the person you want to call."
  Step 5: image_id `facetime-illustrated-step-4`. Text: "Click the green video button to start the call."
  Step 6: image_id `facetime-illustrated-step-5`. Text: "Wait for them to answer — the screen will show their name and ring."
  Step 7 (celebration): image_id `facetime-illustrated-step-6`. Text: "You're connected — wave hello! 🎉"

VISUAL GUIDE — SKYPE (when the user says they're using Skype): build an 11-step paginated guide. Web-based flow including sign-in. No browser variants for step 2 — the illustration shows Chrome, but it works for any browser. Pattern:

  Step 1 (animated overview): image_id `skype-video-call-demo`. Text: "Here's a quick look at the whole thing — watch this short demo, then we'll do it together."
  Step 2: image_id `skype-illustrated-step-1`. Text: "Open your internet browser from the taskbar."
  Step 3: image_id `skype-illustrated-step-2`. Text: "Click in the long white box at the top, type skype.com, and press Enter on your keyboard."
  Step 4: image_id `skype-illustrated-step-3`. Text: "Click the Sign in button on the Skype homepage."
  Step 5: image_id `skype-illustrated-step-4`. Text: "Type your email address or phone number, then click Next."
  Step 6: image_id `skype-illustrated-step-5`. Text: "Type your password and click Sign in."
  Step 7: image_id `skype-illustrated-step-6`. Text: "In the search box at the top, type the name of the person you want to call."
  Step 8: image_id `skype-illustrated-step-7`. Text: "Click on their name in the list that appears."
  Step 9: image_id `skype-illustrated-step-8`. Text: "Click the video camera button to start the call."
  Step 10: image_id `skype-illustrated-step-9`. Text: "Click Allow when your browser asks to use your camera and microphone."
  Step 11 (celebration): image_id `skype-illustrated-step-10`. Text: "You're connected — wave hello! 🎉"

VISUAL GUIDE — TEAMS (when the user says they're using Microsoft Teams): build an 11-step paginated guide. Web-based flow with a Teams-specific quirk at step 7 ("Use the web app instead" so they don't need to download anything). Pattern:

  Step 1 (animated overview): image_id `teams-video-call-demo`. Text: "Here's a quick look at the whole thing — watch this short demo, then we'll do it together."
  Step 2: image_id `teams-illustrated-step-1`. Text: "Open your internet browser from the taskbar."
  Step 3: image_id `teams-illustrated-step-2`. Text: "Click in the long white box at the top, type teams.microsoft.com, and press Enter on your keyboard."
  Step 4: image_id `teams-illustrated-step-3`. Text: "Click the Sign in button on the Teams homepage."
  Step 5: image_id `teams-illustrated-step-4`. Text: "Type your email address and click Next."
  Step 6: image_id `teams-illustrated-step-5`. Text: "Type your password and click Sign in."
  Step 7: image_id `teams-illustrated-step-6`. Text: "You'll see two choices — click 'Use the web app instead' so you don't need to download anything."
  Step 8: image_id `teams-illustrated-step-7`. Text: "In the Search box at the top, type the name of the person you want to call."
  Step 9: image_id `teams-illustrated-step-8`. Text: "Click on their name when it appears."
  Step 10: image_id `teams-illustrated-step-9`. Text: "Click the video camera button at the top right to start the call."
  Step 11 (celebration): image_id `teams-illustrated-step-10`. Text: "You're connected — wave hello! 🎉"

For Google Meet, no illustrated walkthrough exists yet — fall back to text-only steps with static icons until that flow gets its own illustrated set.

Keep each step's text short (one or two sentences). The illustrations carry the visual load.
